sentences.text:
Pranab Dutta & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 23
March, 2023
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh

Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
23.03.2023 Ct. No.34 S/L No.13 Ks C.R.R. 1107 of 2021 Pranab Dutta & Anr.
-Vs.-
The State of West Bengal & Anr.
In Re: An application filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

Mr. Jayanta Narayan Chatterjee Ms. Jayashree Patra Ms. Sreeparna Ghosh .....For the O.P. No.2 Ms.
Anasuya Sinha Mr. Pinak Kumar Mitra .....For the State

The revisional application was preferred for challenging the First Information Report in connection with Jadavpur Police Station Case No.426 of 2020 dated 25.12.2020 under Sections 302/ 201/ 498A/ 406/ 34/ 120B of the Indian Penal Code.
The records of the revisional application reflect that the revisional application was admitted on 29th July, 2021.

Ms. Sinha, learned advocate appears on behalf of the State and submits a report which reflects that the present petitioners, Pranab Dutta and Paromita Dutta were discharged from the case for want of evidence.
Report so submitted be kept with the record.
In view of the aforesaid, the revisional application has become infructuous.
Accordingly, C.R.R. 1107 of 2021 is dismissed as infructuous.
Pending applications, if any, are consequently disposed of.
All parties are directed to act on the server copy of this order downloaded from the official website of this Hon'ble Court.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
